cohort: The study included 72 prepubescent children aged 1 to 10 years and their mothers.
finding: The delivery mode at birth and age are the most influential factors shaping the skin mycobiome in children, with significant association to the maturation of the skin fungal community.
mod_finding: Compared to vaginally born children, caesarean-born children exhibit a skin mycobiome assembled by predominantly deterministic niche-based processes with a more fragile microbial network, and lacked the increasing specialization of fungal structures with age seen in vaginally born children.
